name: sami-mushaf
description: Mus'haf — an Albanian Quran reader by Sami Mustafa with authentic Quran.com Arabic and animated page turns.

scripts.android:build: npm run build && node scripts/build-android.mjs && node scripts/check-android.mjs
scripts.android:sync: npm run android:build && cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && node scripts/android-gradle.mjs assembleDebug
scripts.android:bundle: npm run android:sync && node scripts/android-gradle.mjs bundleRelease
